fix.summary: Re-fetch each selected issue via issuesSvc.getById after selection so the export bundle includes the full description. The list() endpoint truncates descriptions to ~1200 chars (an intentional preview optimization for inbox queries), which was silently dropping everything past the preview cutoff from exported TASK.md files.
